## dc657616ec21

**Possible shortcut, reproduced at lesson level.**  The rival “assign each
panel the class `ceil(min(bbox_height, bbox_width) / 2)`, then output pairwise
class equality” fits both official training pairs.  Against generator SHA-256
`602fc12686d3f81f389ede98dd446bc7d22682f1be6b80b1374c5f9373f54992`,
a deterministic probe generated 400 inputs per band at seed `99173` and tested
all 400 cyclic three-demo windows.  The rival survived 15 easy, 35 medium, and
66 hard windows.  Evidence and exact sampler:
`checks/audit/dc657616ec21/rival_probe.json`.

A concrete hard lesson is sample indices `6, 7, 8`; the rival matches the
selected Racket output on all three.  Sample index `11` is a counterexample:
the intended onion-depth classes are `[3,1,3,2,2]`, while the rival classes are
`[4,1,3,2,2]`, so their equality matrices differ.  All four inputs pass the
target validator and come from its documented ordinary generator domain.  The
inputs, panel facts, rival outputs, and intended outputs are in
`checks/audit/dc657616ec21/counterexample.json`; the supported Racket execution
record is `checks/audit/dc657616ec21/racket.json` (executed rule hash
`51d1d5e43d4d`).

The exact-override stage passed, but the semantic gate separately exits `2`
because the generator declares no executable semantic contract.  See
`checks/audit-stage/dc-override/` and `checks/audit-stage/dc-semantic/`.  No fix
was made as part of this audit.

triage.reason: Both adversarial findings, source-bound reproducers and notes retained; unrelated audit targets unchanged.
